arguments.summary: Program check-in between Edwin (Executive Director) and a program coordinator. The youth workshop is behind after the facilitator cancelled, so it was moved to January, and the coordinator will finish a new workshop outline by Friday. The Tuesday drop-in cancellation from last week was confirmed.

sections.heading: Updates
points: The youth workshop is slipping behind schedule.
The Tuesday drop-in was already cancelled last week, and that is done.

sections.heading: Challenges and blockers
points: Gym booking was in the notes but did not come up in the discussion.

points: Edwin said the coordinator is doing really well in the new role.

sections.heading: Goals and development
points: The youth workshop moves to January rather than being rushed.
A new workshop outline is due this Friday.
Finance will be asked to pay the January facilitator.
